title: Cycling Power Interval Compliance
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), running gait (`gait:metric`), hangboard sessions (`hangboard:session`), golf-swing metrics (`golfswing:metric`), power-meter intervals (`powermeter:interval`), basketball shot arcs (`shotarc:make`).
app: Sports and skill sensors — velocity-based-training bar trackers, running-form IMUs, climbing hangboard load cells, golf launch monitors, cycling power meters, and computer-vision shot trackers — logged to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=powermeter:interval
| eval in_zone=if(avg_watts>=target_watts*0.95 AND avg_watts<=target_watts*1.05,1,0)
| stats sum(in_zone) as hit, count as intervals by workout
| eval compliance=round(100*hit/intervals,1)
| sort compliance
description: Measures how many training intervals you actually held in the target power band, grading how well you executed the workout.
value: A structured session only works if the intervals hit target; a compliance score separates a great workout from a sloppy one.
implementation: Ingest power-meter interval data into `index=personal`; review target-band compliance per workout.
visualization: Bar chart of interval compliance by workout.
grandmaExplanation: It checks how many of your cycling efforts hit the target power, showing how well you followed the training plan.
